issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds (展开卡片以完整提示词代替摘要); attempt-failed/attempt-cancelled/attempt-file-missing
issues.observation: Expanded failed / cancelled / interrupted / file-missing cards keep the prompt summary in the header row AND print the full prompt again below the icon block (e.g. 会失败的一张 twice), whereas expanded completed cards replace the summary with the full prompt. Not a blocking defect, but the same prompt reads twice and the rule is applied inconsistently.
issues.repair_suggestion: For expanded non-image cards, drop the header summary line (or drop the body prompt when it equals the summary) so each expanded card shows the prompt exactly once.

issues.criteria_ref: global (outside image-sessions per-state list); running / running-other-session
issues.observation: While an image attempt is shown as 生成中（已用 0秒） the top bar still reads 媒体：空闲 · 可开下一件重活 / 可开工. In running-other-session-new-empty and busy-other-media the top bar does reflect the job (图片生成中 / 视频生成中), so this looks like header polling lag right after submit rather than wrong logic; the image page itself is correct.
issues.repair_suggestion: Refresh the top-bar status immediately when an image job is submitted (or when the image pane observes a running job), and confirm on batch B (real app) that the header flips to 图片生成中 within a second.

issues.observation: The disabled-reason line is shown twice: once inside the expanded card under the action buttons and again under the composer (「甲会话：正在生成」正在生成图片 / 媒体作业进行中). Required copy is present; the repetition is just visual noise.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optional: keep only the composer status line, or keep the in-card line as a short hint tied to the disabled 换个构图.

issues.observation: runtime-unavailable: header still says 模型文件完整 · 可离线生成 while generation is impossible; both states keep the empty hint 点「生成图片」 although the button is disabled. Status lines themselves are correct.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optional: when the runtime is missing, drop 可离线生成 from the header; consider muting the empty-state instruction when 生成图片 is disabled.

issues.observation: The timeline area is completely empty; the reason sits only in the left column and the status line. Meets the criteria (list shows reason + 重试, status 会话还没加载好).
issues.repair_suggestion: Optional: echo a short centred hint in the timeline (e.g. 会话列表读不出来，点左侧「重试」).

issues.observation: The frame is scrolled to the preview, so page tabs/header are not in view and the 'image page no longer lists the session' half is not visible here; it is evidenced by verify-after-delete-*. The library preview shows a real image and the item is listed.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optional: capture library-after-delete scrolled to top or add a paired image-page shot next to it.

summary: All 54 screenshots (27 states x wide/narrow) opened and judged. Layout (session list + 新会话, timeline, composer with folded 高级参数) is intact at both widths; no occlusion, clipping, horizontal scroll, blank/broken image frames, or 种子 on the image page. Every per-state must-show item is visible. Two minor issues (duplicated prompt on expanded non-image cards; top bar shows 媒体：空闲 right after an image job starts) and four notes.
